waveyelytra.options.title: WaveyElytra
waveyelytra.options.enabled.tooltip: Replace the vanilla elytra with the 3D wings that have physics. Off draws the flat vanilla elytra.
waveyelytra.options.meshQuality.tooltip: How many bendable segments each wing has.
waveyelytra.options.helicopter.tooltip: In flight the wings meet at the middle of the back and spin like a helicopter rotor. The faster you fly, the faster it spins.
waveyelytra.options.helicopterSound.tool: In helicopter mode the rotor sound replaces the elytra flight sound. Only works while Helicopter is on.
waveyelytra.options.stiffness.tooltip: How firmly the wings keep their shape on the ground. 0 is limp like a cape.
waveyelytra.options.wingWeight.tooltip: How heavy the wings are: how much they sag and swing on the ground. 100% is normal, 0% is weightless.
waveyelytra.options.airDrag.tooltip: How far the wings swing back when you walk or run.
waveyelytra.options.flutter.tooltip: Wave along the wings while moving on the ground. There is no ripple in flight.
waveyelytra.options.maxBendDegrees.toolt: Largest bend between two neighbouring wing segments.
waveyelytra.options.simulationRange.tool: Players further away (blocks) keep their last wing pose.
waveyelytra.options.lowQualityRange.tool: Players further away (blocks) use the low segment count.
